coverageNote.note: PepsiCo's company-owned beverage and foods network (PBNA, Gatorade, Quaker) last disclosed ~65 plants and ~440 distribution facilities for the beverage division alone (FY2017 10-K; current counts undisclosed). We audited 30 flagship company-owned plants and DCs. Frito-Lay is audited separately.

account.dossierIntro: We mapped 30 PepsiCo flagship plants and distribution centers from public satellite imagery: 1,145 dock doors, almost 3,000 trailer positions, 990 acres of yard. 24 of these 30 sites run drop yards, and 26 sit behind long entry drives. PepsiCo is scaling driverless freight with Gatik, yet every one of these yards still checks trucks in on guard shacks, radios, and clipboards. That is where one network standard would land first.
surprisingFindings: Brookshire TX runs 120 dock doors, the most in the network, on one mixing-center roofline. Two truck gates decide whether all of them stay fed.
Only 3 of 30 audited sites are rail-served. The other 27 move everything by truck, so the yard is the only place left to win the turn.
26 of 30 sites sit behind long entry drives where the queue backs toward the road. The driverless trucks PepsiCo is adding with Gatik still wait in that line.
account.networkCountSource: YardFlow estimate of PepsiCo's North American production and distribution footprint, extrapolated from the 30 sites we satellite-mapped. PepsiCo's FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 2 Properties lists significant properties by segment and publishes no total facility count (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747626000007/pep-20251227.htm).
account.sampleRationale: We mapped flagship company-owned plants and DCs spanning PBNA, Gatorade, and Quaker, biggest to smallest and most to least automated; the yard pattern held across all 30.

sites.dossierExcerpt:
Roster geocode (ROOFTOP, 38.483235, -121.398536) lands on a large white-roof
beverage facility with a solar-paneled west section, a huge route-truck fleet yard
on the west side, and blue-trimmed (Pepsi blue) office frontage on Reese Rd ,
matching the D&B Pepsi-Cola Metropolitan Bottling listing for 7550 Reese Rd.
Street View 2025-03 on Reese Rd shows the gated entrances and the blue building.
Locked center: 38.48324, -121.39854.

fieldNotes.truckGate: Both Reese Rd entrances are fenced with sliding vehicle gates (Street View 2025-03): the NE drive into the north truck court and the south front drive (chain-link gate rolled open, safety/check-in placards on the fence, yellow bollard).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at either gate in 2025-03 Street View or z19/z20 overhead; a small red kiosk-sized post sits beside the NE drive throat - reads as card-reader/kiosk check-in, so remoteGs=true. Flagged: a guard could sit inside the adjacent office wing.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock rows on the SW face (solar-roof section, ~12 positions), south center (~6 under canopy), and north face (~8); ~19 trailers visibly backed in. Estimated ~24-26 total doors; band 10-25 chosen conservatively.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: North-face docks face the shared truck court (receiving) while south/SW docks face the fleet yard (route loading) - distinct dock clusters on opposite faces.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large west fleet yard: rows of trailers along the north fence plus ~100 route trucks; trailer-only stalls est 25-50. South fence row holds route trucks.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the south boundary but no spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: The large DC immediately north (own dock row facing south) is a separate property; the shared-looking court is split along the drive line used as the north perimeter edge.

citations.claim: Active PepsiCo production/warehouse/maintenance reqs at West Sacramento
The West Sacramento bottling closure was Manna Beverages (a non-PepsiCo copacker), NOT PepsiCo, ruled out as a distractor

verification.rationale: PBNA Sacramento actively hiring; the nearby abrupt closure was Manna Beverages, a non-PepsiCo copacker.

sites.name: PBNA - Las Vegas NV

steps.step: Arrive at gate (no guard, kiosk or call box)

sites.dossierExcerpt:
Roster geocode (GEOMETRIC_CENTER, 36.071804, -115.234118) lands on the large
bottling + distribution campus at Sunset Rd between Rainbow and Lindell, matching
the Packaging Gateway profile (387,400 sq ft, built 2008). Street View 2025-02 from
Sunset Rd shows the Pepsi globe on the facade, a Gatorade trailer in the front lot,
and the blue entrance canopy. Positive ID. Locked center: 36.07220, -115.23410.

fieldNotes.truckGate: The entire operational yard is enclosed by a tall tan block wall (confirmed on the Sunset Rd, north, and east sides in Street View). The only truck access is the NE-corner curb cut off the east street into the perimeter drive - a walled single-throat yard implies a controlled gate, but the gate hardware itself was not resolvable in z20 overhead or reachable Street View; flagged.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth observed at the NE throat or front; front visitor lot on Sunset Rd is open car parking with the Pepsi-globe lobby (blue canopy). remoteGs=true follows from gate-without-shack but inherits the gate uncertainty.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: West-face dock row toward the fleet yard (~12-14 trailers backed), east-face row (~6-8), plus north DC-section positions; 387,400 sq ft bottling+distribution building (Packaging Gateway) supports a 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on opposite faces: west row serves route/fleet loading, east row faces the inbound perimeter drive.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer rows in the walled north yard (~18) and middle yard (~10), plus pallet/shell stacks; route trucks throughout.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Semis were queued curbside on the west street in 2022 Street View, but that street fronts a separate (ex-Helix Electric) laydown parcel - not counted as Pepsi staging.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Main plant plus a SW outbuilding inside one walled campus; the trailer strip west of the wall is a separate parcel and was excluded from the perimeter.

citations.claim: Pepsi Beverages Company Las Vegas bottling + distribution center (387,400 sqft, two buildings)

verification.rationale: Purpose-built PBNA bottling+distribution campus, no closure signal.

sites.name: PBNA - Munster IN
sites.dossierExcerpt:
Roster geocode (ROOFTOP, 41.544577, -87.509931) lands on a large multi-section
industrial complex on the west side of Calumet Ave. Identity confirmed by the
fleet signature: dozens of the distinctive silver Pepsi side-loader route trailers
parked in herringbone rows across the yard (NW yard, center-east yard, rail-side
row), CO2/silo equipment on the north side, and heavy pallet/shell laydown along
the west wall. Matches the roster's 350+ employee PBNA bottling description.
Locked center: 41.54480, -87.51130.

fieldNotes.truckGate: No gate found at any access: the north entrance drive off Calumet Ave (by the Starbucks outparcel, where an Averitt semi was turning in on 2024-06 Street View) is an open yellow-hatched drive; the inner court entries off the east-west access road show no barrier; the south Calumet drive is also open. Open-campus pattern.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure at any entrance in satellite or 2024-06 Street View.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Trailers backed on the plant's west face (~10), north court (~8), plus route-loading positions on the east building; ~20 trailers visibly docked, estimated ~30 doors across faces.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Distinctive silver Pepsi side-loader route trailers in herringbone rows: NW yard (~20), center-east yard (~15), plus a diagonal row staged along the rail corridor (~6).
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the SW boundary with what may be an old spur alignment toward the plant's SW corner; no active spur into the property could be confirmed - set false, flagged.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: The audited parcel is the Pepsi complex (main multi-section plant + east building + south warehouse). The large DC north of the access road and the flex/office buildings south of the south drive are separate properties and were excluded.

citations.claim: Active PepsiCo fleet/electro-mechanical technician + ops reqs at Munster IN

verification.rationale: PBNA Munster bottling plant actively hiring; the IN closure was Muncie (different city), not Munster.

sites.name: PBNA - Twinsburg OH
sites.dossierExcerpt:
Roster coords landed directly on a ~225m-wide industrial complex fronting Enterprise
Pkwy (west) and E Highland Rd (south), backed by a rail corridor (north). Street View
at both south curb cuts shows Pepsi-branded trailers, Pepsi banners on the perimeter
fence, a Pepsi sign at the east drive, and stacks of blue Pepsi bottle shells in the
yard. Identity is certain.

fieldNotes.truckGate: Main truck drive off E Highland Rd (west curb cut) is a wide open multi-lane concrete drive with no barrier, gate, or booth (Street View 2021-09). A secondary east drive has a manual chain-link sliding gate with a Pepsi sign, but it is not the primary controlled entrance.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Main drive is a very wide unmarked concrete apron; no painted lane separation, so lane counts left null.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks on the NE (gray) building face (~12-14 trailers docked) plus the main building SE corner bank (~8-10) and east-face positions; band 25-50 is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dense trailer rows fill the east yard between the building and the pond, running from the rail corridor to E Highland Rd; 60+ drop positions plus a long nose-in row along the pond edge.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: A dark-roof warehouse parcel at the SE corner sits inside the traced perimeter; Pepsi blue bottle shells are stacked around it (Street View), so it appears operationally Pepsi, but parcel ownership was not verified.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically distinct dock clusters (NE gray-building bank vs main-building SE/east banks) suggest separate ship/receive; inferred from overhead only.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail corridor runs along the north boundary but no spur visibly enters the property.

citations.claim: The only recent Twinsburg WARN at Enterprise Pkwy is Giesecke+Devrient (different company), NOT Pepsi, confirms no Pepsi closure

verification.rationale: No Pepsi closure/divestiture found; Twinsburg WARN belongs to a different firm; current PepsiCo NE-Ohio production/distribution facility.

sites.name: PBNA - Cheverly MD

steps.step: Arrive at gate, queue spills into traffic

sites.dossierExcerpt:
The landmark plant beside the Baltimore-Washington Pkwy. Street View from the south
road shows the PEPSI sign on the building; the yard is full of Pepsi-branded trailers
and blue bottle shells; Pepsi Pl dead-ends at the plant's roundabout. Identity certain.

fieldNotes.truckGate: Single truck entrance at the west end of the Pepsi Pl cul-de-sac roundabout: chain-link fence both sides, gate hardware, 5-mph and STOP signage, and trucks pass under a large steel check-in canopy (Street View 2022-07).
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small tan booth-sized structure with a STOP sign sits beside the lane at the canopy; reads as a staffed check-in booth but could be a utility/office shed - flagged.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Gate sits ~40-50m from the public roundabout terminating Pepsi Pl; a 3+ truck queue would block the circle. Pepsi Pl is a low-traffic dead-end, so impact is mostly self-inflicted.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South-face bank (~12 trailers docked) + east-face angled bank (~12-15); ~26 doors estimated, near the 25-50 band lower edge.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large SE drop yard with dense angled rows (~45 trailers in one z19 frame) plus a NE trailer/shell yard north of the canopy.
fieldNotes.coords: Roster geocode (RANGE_INTERPOLATED, 38.926196,-76.927503) landed ~150m SW of the plant on the road; corrected center to the building at 38.9267,-76.9256.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible; site is bounded by BW Parkway greenery and local roads.

citations.claim: Active PepsiCo reqs (Warehouse Supervisor, Inventory Coordinator, Production Coordinator) at 2611 Pepsi Place, Cheverly MD

verification.rationale: Active PepsiCo warehouse/production reqs at the Cheverly Pepsi Place address confirm current self-operation (DC/bottling).

sites.name: PBNA - Piscataway NJ
sites.dossierExcerpt:
Roster point landed on a ~37-acre single-tenant campus: a very large solar-paneled
production/warehouse building, a north fleet building, an SE office annex, trailer
yards west and south, and big car lots east. The black perimeter fence, monument-sign
entrance, and route-fleet vans match the known PBNA company-owned NJ production site.
No competing candidate nearby. Identity confirmed (high).

fieldNotes.truckGate: Both road entrances (north drive off New Brunswick Ave, east car entrance with monument sign) are open driveways with no barrier or booth visible from Street View (2025-09/10) or z20 satellite. The perimeter IS fenced (black fence along the east road), so an internal control point deeper in the yard is possible but not visible - flagged.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long south-face dock bank (~25-35 positions) plus a north-face bank (~15-20); ~45 total estimated from overhead.
fieldNotes.dropArea: West trailer yard (~25), a long south trailer row (~25), plus rows along the north pad; 85 trailers visible across frames.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: North-face and south-face dock banks are physically distinct clusters; inferred from overhead.
fieldNotes.northPad: Rows under what appear to be solar carport canopies on the north pad may also hold trailers; excluded from drop-yard rings due to canopy ambiguity.
fieldNotes.coords: Roster geocode (GEOMETRIC_CENTER) was on the property; locked center adjusted to the main building rooftop at 40.57735,-74.44230.

citations.claim: PepsiCo 2024 bottling closures were Cincinnati, Chicago, Harrisburg PA, Atlanta, Piscataway NOT among them
2022 fire caused a temporary closure of the Piscataway Pepsi plant; plant since reopened

verification.rationale: Only negative is a temporary 2022 fire (reopened); not on the 2024 closure list, active PepsiCo bottling plant.

sites.name: PBNA - Knoxville TN

steps.step: Arrive at gate (no guard, kiosk or call box)

sites.dossierExcerpt:
Roster point landed on a ~10.6-acre plant/DC bounded by Middlebrook Pike (south) and
a local road (east). Street View shows a PEPSI trailer at the entrance, Pepsi truck
inside the fence, and a signed "TRUCK ENTRANCE". Identity certain.

fieldNotes.truckGate: Signed 'TRUCK ENTRANCE' on the east road (Street View 2026-01): chain-link fence with a sliding gate across the truck drive (open at capture). Perimeter is fenced with barbed wire.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No guard booth visible at the gate in SV or z20 satellite, implying remote/uncontrolled check-in; a booth deeper in the yard cannot be fully ruled out.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Gate sits ~25-30m off the public road; a 2-truck queue reaches the street.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~8-12 OTR positions on the main building east face plus a covered route-truck canopy bank (north building, ~12-15 bays); ~22 total, near the 10-25/25-50 boundary.
fieldNotes.dropArea: ~25 trailers visible across the NE yard and scattered positions (incl. third-party CFI trailers); band 10-25 chosen at the boundary.

fieldNotes.coords: Roster GEOMETRIC_CENTER point was on-property; locked center moved to the main building rooftop.

citations.claim: Active PBNA reqs in Knoxville (Warehouse Order Selector, Transport Unloader, CDL-A Local Delivery Driver, Merchandiser)

sites.name: Quaker Oats - Cedar Rapids IA
sites.dossierExcerpt:
Unmistakable: the dense legacy mill complex on the east bank of the Cedar River,
downtown Cedar Rapids. Street View from the south street shows PEPSICO and QUAKER
signage on the brick mill block. Identity certain.

fieldNotes.truckGate: The visible truck access - the SE dock apron curb cut off the public street (PEPSICO/QUAKER signed building, SV 2021-09) - is an open apron with no barrier or booth; trucks back to docks essentially off the street. An interior control for the north rail-side trailer yard could not be observed (no SV coverage inside) - flagged.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Downtown setting: dock maneuvering and any queue happens at the public street edge next to a freeway ramp block.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South dock building (~10-14 angled positions) + an east-face bank (~8); mill buildings load via rail and internal bays; ~22 truck doors estimated.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Main trailer rows sit in the north yard between the elevator/silos and the rail corridor (~20-25), plus scattered south positions; ~40 visible.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two distinct large clusters on one property: the downtown mill cluster (silos + production + docks) and the north warehouse/elevator with its own yard, linked by an overhead conveyor.
fieldNotes.railServed: Heavily rail-served: mainline + multiple spurs with hopper-car strings along the east side; unit-train loading at the north elevator.
fieldNotes.scale: A truck scale is plausible at a mill this size but none was identifiable overhead.
fieldNotes.perimeter: Bounded by the Cedar River (west), the rail corridor (east), the north elevator yard, and the downtown street (south). Parcel lines vs operational footprint are approximate in the NE rail zone.
fieldNotes.coords: Roster geocode (GEOMETRIC_CENTER, moved 124m) was on the complex; locked center set mid-complex at 41.98220,-91.67100.

citations.claim: The 2023-24 salmonella recall/closure was the DANVILLE IL Quaker plant, not Cedar Rapids; production shifted to Cedar Rapids
Active Quaker/PepsiCo Cedar Rapids reqs confirm the plant is operating

verification.rationale: The recall/shutdown was Danville IL, not Cedar Rapids, Cedar Rapids absorbed Danville’s production; large long-running plant still operating.

sites.name: Quaker Oats - Bridgeview IL
sites.dossierExcerpt:
Roster pin sat directly on the large mixed dark/white-roof production complex filling
the block north of W 71st St, west of the rail embankment (71st dips under the rail
just east of the plant). Brick office fronting 71st, dock canopies, and a rail spur
into the yard all match a legacy Quaker production plant. Identity confirmed.

fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier, gate, or booth visible at any street curb cut: the west truck drive off 71st St is open (SV 2025-04, trucks rolling straight in to the SW dock pocket), the east drive serves the office/employee lots. Interior control deeper in the yard cannot be ruled out - flagged.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South-face canopy bank (~8-12 doors), NE dock court on the north building (~6-10), plus a SW dock pocket off the west drive (~6); ~24 total, at the 10-25/25-50 boundary.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Few drop trailers visible (~12 incl. pneumatic bulk trailers at the rail transfer); the large internal concrete yard is mostly empty maneuvering/staging space, not a trailer storage lot - hence dropYard false.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur curves off the IHB/BRC mainline into the NE yard (covered-hopper string on the main, bulk-transfer trailers at the spur). 71st St passes under the rail just east of the plant.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: South canopy bank vs NE dock court are physically separate clusters; inferred from overhead.
fieldNotes.westDrive: The west drive is shared with the neighboring distribution building (excluded from the perimeter); the boundary is drawn at the drive edge.
fieldNotes.northBoundary: Quaker parcel ends at the fence/green strip ~41.7646; the big white DC north of it is a separate facility.

citations.claim: The closed Quaker IL plant was DANVILLE (510 layoffs), not Bridgeview
Quaker (PepsiCo) EXPANDED Bridgeview IL with a new production line

verification.rationale: Closed IL Quaker plant was Danville, not Bridgeview; Bridgeview was expanded with a new line, active PepsiCo/Quaker plant.

sites.name: Quaker Oats - Columbia MO

citations.claim: PepsiCo Quaker Oats active manufacturer at 4501 Paris Rd, Columbia MO; rice-cake plant ~260 employees 24/7

sites.name: PBNA - Smyrna TN (DC)
sites.dossierExcerpt:
Rooftop geocode lands on the SE-most of three large white-roofed buildings in a new
logistics park on the I-24 frontage in Smyrna. Web confirmation: PBNA opened a nearly
400,000 sq ft warehouse/DC at 2020 Midway Ln on Aug 6, 2024, its largest in the
Southeast and 2nd largest nationally, replacing the downtown Nashville warehouse
(PR Newswire / REBusinessOnline / WGNS). The pinned building's footprint and "new
construction" state match. Identity: confirmed.

fieldNotes.imagery: ALL available satellite imagery and Street View (latest pano 2023-10) predate completion, the site is mid-construction in every source. The DC opened Aug 2024 (PBNA press release). Yard-control features (gate, guard booth, trailer rows, striping) are NOT yet visible and the gate fields below are honest defaults, not observations.
fieldNotes.truckGate: not visible in construction-stage imagery; PBNA standard design and the single-access geometry make a controlled gate at the SE truck-court entrance likely once operational, flagged, not asserted
fieldNotes.dockDoors: dock pockets visible along the SE face during construction; ~30 estimated for a ~400k sq ft beverage DC, band 25-50
fieldNotes.dropArea: depressed truck court with retaining wall built along the I-24 side; trailer stalls not yet striped in imagery, so banded NONE with low confidence
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: the E/SE truck court between the dock wall and the I-24 retaining wall provides clear post-entry holding space by design
fieldNotes.urbanRural: new logistics park on the I-24 frontage at Smyrna's edge, subdivisions nearby but edge-of-town setting -> Rural per rubric
fieldNotes.buildingIdentity: rooftop geocode of 2020 Midway Ln lands on the SE-most building of the 3-building park; ~400k sq ft footprint matches the PBNA press release (largest PBNA DC in the Southeast)

citations.claim: PBNA official PR: new ~400,000 sq ft Smyrna TN warehouse/DC, second-largest PBNA in US, grand opening Aug 2024

verification.rationale: Brand-new PBNA-operated DC opened Aug 2024, self-attested; no negatives.

sites.name: PepsiCo - Brookshire TX (1NA Mixing Center DC)
sites.dossierExcerpt:
The rooftop geocode landed on Kingsland Blvd between two giant warehouses. Disambiguated
by measurement + web research: PepsiCo signed Houston's largest 2025 industrial lease
(1.05M sq ft) at Hunt Southwest's spec I-10 West Trade Center, move-in Oct 1 2025
(CommercialSearch, Houston Chronicle/HBJ, Traded.co). The building NORTH of Kingsland
measures ~650m x 150m = ~97k m2 = ~1.05M sq ft, an exact match; the complex south of
Kingsland is the Ross import DC (massive container field, different operation). Locked
to the north building, center 29.7663,-95.9152.

fieldNotes.truckGate: as of the latest imagery (sat + Street View 2025-04, pre-PepsiCo move-in Oct 2025) the site is a completely open spec build: no perimeter fence along Kingsland Blvd, no gate, no booth at either access. PepsiCo may have added gating during fit-out, flagged
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: multiple uncontrolled access points: E end onto the NE-SW park road and W end onto the western park road; S dock court reached around either building end
fieldNotes.dockDoors: true cross-dock ~1.05M sq ft (Hunt Southwest I-10 West Trade Center): the S face alone shows 60+ dock doors in a continuous run in Street View; N face has additional doors at the NE section. dockDoorCount=120 is a design estimate, 50+ band is certain
fieldNotes.dropArea: ~40 tractorless trailers visible (E-end column + N-end rows); long striped trailer rows in the S court were empty at capture. Capacity is far higher (est 200+)
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: cross-dock with dock banks on both long faces
fieldNotes.buildingIdentity: geocode pin sits on Kingsland Blvd between this building and the Ross DC complex to the south; footprint measurement (~650m x 150m = ~1.05M sq ft) plus news coverage (largest Houston industrial lease 2025, move-in Oct 2025) pins PepsiCo to the NE building
fieldNotes.urbanRural: I-10 logistics corridor at Brookshire, open fields and prairie around the park -> Rural

citations.claim: PepsiCo/Frito-Lay 1M sq ft 1NA Mixing Center combining Pepsi/Frito-Lay/Quaker under one roof in Brookshire TX

verification.rationale: Confirmed PepsiCo-operated 1NA Mixing Center DC in Brookshire/Katy area, leased and newly opened 2025.

citations.claim: 605,412 sq ft Lakeland FL DC leased to Quaker Sales and Distribution Inc (wholly-owned PepsiCo subsidiary), regional DC for Gatorade

fieldNotes.siteIdentity: building fascia carries PEPSICO branding (2025-06 SV); new ~126k sq ft DC built after the NE Portland plant demolition (VLMK/Perlo project pages); operates as Pepsi Northwest Beverages

citations.claim: New 126,360 sq ft Pepsi DC in Clackamas County replacing the Portland facility; 12 docks, trailer parking/charging
Active PepsiCo job reqs in Clackamas OR (current hiring)

sites.name: PBNA - Detroit MI (DC)

steps.step: Route to correct building / drop yard

sites.dossierExcerpt:
Rooftop geocode lands on the large gray-roofed plant on the north side of Mack Ave at
the NE-running boulevard, Detroit east side, the former PBNA Detroit bottling plant
(production ended Sept 2025 per CBS Detroit/Food Dive; warehouse/distribution
